methods.label: Multiply every term by 10
methods.explanation: Multiplying the numerator \(0.2x+0.5\) by 10 gives \(2x+5\), and multiplying the denominator \(0.3x-0.1\) by 10 gives \(3x-1\). Thus, \(a=2\), \(b=3\), and \(a+b=5\).
